Product photograph for an online store gallery, square frame: a low side view of the white neck pillow at mattress level, showing its profile, the higher back roll (13 cm) and the lower front roll (11 cm) with the dip between them, resting on a bed made with white cotton percale.
Soft morning daylight from a large window behind the camera on the right; the far side of the room falls into a soft, warm-grey blur; the sheet in front of the pillow is slightly out of focus.
Shot with an 85 mm lens at f/4, ISO 400, camera at the height of the pillow, 1.2 m away. The pillow is placed slightly left of center and fills about 70 percent of the frame width; its underside presses flat into the mattress with a soft contact shadow.

Image 1 shows the exact product's shape and Image 2 shows its real knit cover. Reproduce this exact pillow and do not redesign it: a wide, low, cloud-shaped memory foam pillow, 62 cm wide, 42 cm deep, 13 cm high at the back roll and 11 cm at the front roll; soft rounded lobes along the outline, a broad rounded wing on each side at the base; one small fabric-covered button in a shallow dimple at the center of the top; at the middle of the front edge, a short rounded tongue with seven shallow round nubs, four in the back row and three in the front row. The cover is white cotton jersey knit with fine stitch rows, a few soft natural wrinkles and a slightly puckered seam. It is dense, heavy foam that rests with its weight, never inflated or plush-toy-like. No extra lobes, buttons, zips, tags or piping.

It must be indistinguishable from an unretouched photograph taken by a professional photographer in a real home: natural window light with a warm direct side and cool bluish ambient shade, true optical depth of field with smooth bokeh, slight chromatic softness toward the corners, fine sensor noise, small real-world imperfections (a stray fold, a faint crease, dust motes in the light, slightly uneven textiles), the pillow not perfectly aligned with the frame. No people or faces, no text, logo, watermark or label, no CGI or 3D render look, no waxy or airbrushed surfaces, no glossy plastic, no cutout or pasted-on look, no saturated or powder blue, no HDR, no oversharpening.
